scientific_integrity: The established general telegraph first-passage law is prior work, not claimed as original. The new claim is the constrained global boundary allocation theorem, crossover, and sharp critical-rate variance tie-break. Self-review completed; independent review unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Pointlike instantaneous Bernoulli capture at two reflecting endpoints only; identical speed for both velocity states, Poisson reversals, midpoint and unbiased initial direction, and a fixed sum of per-collision capture probabilities. The theorem concerns mean eventual absorption and its variance only at the critical rate; it makes no priority claim against inaccessible or differently termed earlier work.
title: Boundary-capture allocation transition and variance selection for a persistent particle
